quotes.text: Captain Andy was awesome!!!!! Highly recommend his charter service! We were a family of five from Zanesville Ohio! He baited our hooks and when I was too small to reel in my fish he jumped in and helped! Loved it! I would definitely use his services again!!!!! If you are in the area , look him up! He cleaned our fish, gave me recipes to cook the fish! Furnished the cooler and ice to keep the fish on hold for us. He went well beyond his duty to please us. The MOZENA FAMILY thank you Captain Andy! If you are ever in Ohio look us up!

Captain Andy was awesome! And a very reasonable price. We had a great day catching a ton of fish, laughing, and snapping beautiful pictures. Andy was Johnny-on-the-spot baiting our lines, taking our fish off the hook, ensuring we followed all of the conservation best practices on what we kept and what we released, and putting the keepers on ice. At the end of the day, he cleaned the fish and we left with a ton of great tasting filets.

One of the BEST charters I have ever been on. This guy will put you on the FISH! We had fresh live Mackerel in MINUTES….(one of his secrets), and were were off to catch the BIG ones. Time we were done, we all had our limit of Haddock, a few Cusk and 10 Pollock. He even stayed out a little later for us as we were not on time on our arrival to his boat. Great day out fishing for a reasonable price, with a great captain , Captain Andy!

12/11/2018 Had a great time, Weather was perfect and the crew were amazing. Caught lots of fish and I even saw a whale!! Best experience Iv had in a long time. I would recommend anybody who loves the ocean and fishing to do this charter!!
